grammarFocus: 比较级；最高级；方式与时间介词；how long / how often。
title: A New Bus Route in My City
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文和问题都是模拟材料，不是官方雅思试题。请仔细阅读短文，根据短文内容选择或填写答案。填空题的答案必须与短文中的单词完全一致，且不超过字数限制。
passage: My name is Li Wei. I live in a small city in China. Last year, the city started a new bus route. The route is called Bus 15. It goes from the train station to the university. Before Bus 15, I took Bus 7 to work. Bus 7 was slower than Bus 15. It took 45 minutes. Now, Bus 15 takes only 25 minutes. So, Bus 15 is faster than Bus 7. It is also cheaper. Bus 7 cost 3 yuan, but Bus 15 costs 2 yuan. Bus 15 is the cheapest bus in my city. Many people like it. The bus comes every 10 minutes. It is very frequent. I take Bus 15 every day. I usually take it at 7:30 in the morning. I get to work at 8:00. In the evening, I take it at 6:00. The bus is often crowded in the morning. But it is never late. The drivers are friendly. They say hello to everyone. The bus is clean and quiet. I like Bus 15 very much. It makes my life easier. My friend, Zhang Min, also takes Bus 15. She works at the university. She takes the bus at 8:00. She says it is the best bus in the city. Sometimes, we take the bus together. We talk about our day. The bus is a good place to meet friends. I think Bus 15 is a great idea. I hope more buses like this come to my city.

短文提到“Bus 7 cost 3 yuan, but Bus 15 costs 2 yuan.”，所以Bus 15更便宜。

questions.explanation: 短文说“The bus comes every 10 minutes.”，所以Bus 15每10分钟一班。

questions.evidence: I usually take it at 7:30 in the morning.

questions.explanation: 短文说“It goes from the train station to the university.”，所以填university。

grammar.title: 比较级和最高级；方式与时间介词；how long / how often
grammar.explanation: 比较级用于比较两个事物，如“faster than”（比…更快）。最高级用于三个或以上事物中最突出的，如“the cheapest”（最便宜的）。方式介词如“by bus”（乘公交），时间介词如“at 7:30”（在7:30）。“how long”问时间长度，“how often”问频率。
grammar.example: Bus 15 is faster than Bus 7. It is the cheapest bus in my city. I take it at 7:30. The bus comes every 10 minutes.

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses the comparative?
options: Bus 15 is more fast than Bus 7.
questions.explanation: 比较级要在形容词后加-er，并用than连接，所以“faster than”正确。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses the superlative?
options: Bus 15 is the cheapest bus in my city.
Bus 15 is cheapest bus in my city.
Bus 15 is the most cheap bus in my city.
Bus 15 is cheaper bus in my city.
answers: Bus 15 is the cheapest bus in my city.
questions.explanation: 最高级前要加the，且单音节形容词加-est，所以“the cheapest”正确。
questions.evidence: Bus 15 is the cheapest bus in my city.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct preposition: I usually take the bus ____ 7:30.
questions.explanation: 具体时间点前用介词at，如“at 7:30”。
questions.evidence: I usually take it at 7:30 in the morning.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question for the answer: 'Every 10 minutes.'
options: How long does the bus take?
How often does the bus come?
How far is the bus stop?
answers: How often does the bus come?
questions.explanation: 回答“Every 10 minutes”表示频率，所以问句用“How often”。
